title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.7.6
body_markdown:
*released Oct 24th, 2023*

### Summary of What's New in this Release of Visual Studio 2022 version 17.7.6

* Fixed a hang when opening database projects in the presence of Devart extension.
* Fixed a crash when adding a new sqllite (and similar) connected service from the Solution Explorer context menu.

### Developer Community

* [Visual Studio 2022 Preview 17.7.0 Preview 6 started to copy all solutions files to remote linux server](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-2022-Preview-1770-Previe/10429454)
* [Catastrophic Failure (Exception from HRESULT: 0x8000FFF (E\_UNEXPECTED)) when opening file with 3'rd party extensions](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Catostrophic-Failure-Exception-from-HRE/10461123)
* [Opening "Register Visual Studio" does not work](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Opening-Register-Visual-Studio-does-no/10442391)
* [Source Control plugin reverts back to 'Git' when solution is loaded after having been changed to 'None'](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Source-Control-plugin-reverts-back-to-G/10468496)
* [remote Git operations are very slow](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/remote-Git-operations-are-very-slow/10467339)

### Security Advisories Republished

* [**CVE-2023-36799**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36799) A vulnerability exists in .NET where reading a maliciously crafted X.509 certificate may result in Denial of Service. This issue only affects Linux systems.
* [**CVE-2023-36796**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36796)This security update addresses a vulnerability in DiaSymReader.dll when reading a corrupted PDB file which can lead to Remote Code Execution.
* [**CVE-2023-36794**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36794)This security update addresses a vulnerability in DiaSymReader.dll when reading a corrupted PDB file which can lead to Remote Code Execution.
* [**CVE-2023-36793**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36793)This security update addresses a vulnerability in DiaSymReader.dll when reading a corrupted PDB file which can lead to Remote Code Execution.
* [**CVE-2023-36792**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36792)This security update addresses a vulnerability in DiaSymReader.dll when reading a corrupted PDB file which can lead to Remote Code Execution.
